caseName: Rothstein v. Lutheran Social Services of Wisconsin & Upper Michigan
caseNameFull: Rothstein v. Lutheran Social Services of Wisconsin and Upper Michigan

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Wis. Motion to strike appellant's supplemental brief denied. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of Stanley v. Illinois, ante, p. 645, and with due consideration for the completion of adoption proceedings and the fact that the child has apparently, lived with the adoptive family for the intervening period of time.
